article.story: COLLEGE STATION, Texas -- — Jordan Pope scored 18 points, Mackenzie Mgbako added 14 points, and Texas A&M rolled past Northern Kentucky 104-67 on Friday night. Mgbako led the Aggies (2-0) with seven rebounds and four assists. They had a 56-22 advantage in paint points and six players scored in double figures. Willie Foster led Northern Kentucky (2-1) with 23 points. The Aggies scored the game's first 11 points and shot it at a torrid pace through much of the first half. They led 32-20 halfway through the period while shooting 62%. A 13-0 run later in the half pushed their lead to 50-27. The Aggies had runs of 12-0 and 14-0 in the final 10 minutes. They forced 23 turnovers with 15 steals and added nine blocked shots. Texas A&M shot 61% for the first half and 54% for the game. Texas A&M is averaging 100.5 points through two games. Up next Texas A&M: vs. UL Monroe on Monday.
